sourceScope: Full report, physical pages 19-64 (Chapter 1), not the external Chapter 1 granule
method: Source-render annotation of chapter/numbered section titles, plus classification of every emitted heading in the 46-page sample. Subordinate bold and run-in titles are outside the recall denominator. One reviewer; no inter-rater measurement.
limitations: No full-book heading recall or subordinate-heading score
Map labels are visually readable in preserved images, not reconstructed semantic labels
Timeline row/column associations are not qualified by the label review
Multi-line running headers and fewer than three occurrences remain unsupported
